source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-04: generalized direct product (tools/own_arrays/prod2.py; Colbourn and Torres-Jimenez 2013, Cor. 4.3) of the table's own CA(22; 2, 107, 3) (array CA_22_2_107_3_eed6545c) and CA(15; 2, 20, 3) (array CA_15_2_20_3_fd13075b), giving CA(35; 2, 2140, 3); then column extension at fixed N (own program caex.c after the CA Extender of Torres-Jimenez, Acevedo-Juarez and Avila-George 2021: each new column found by local search on that column, then simulated annealing on the whole array with the moves and restarts of Avila-George, Torres-Jimenez and Hernandez 2012) to 2611 columns in the cloud and to 2756 columns on the Mac; exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs
construction: Generalized direct product of our arrays then column extension at fixed N
notes: beats the Torres-Jimenez size 35 at k = 2700 by 56 columns; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start; the CA Extender and the annealer are credited as methods
